goal: The revisit audit report adds a Candidate improvements evidence section (repeat groups, infrastructure jitter, high-round per-run listings), dist/revisit.md carries the WER section 3-4 follow-through method with the fix ladder and the report-only rule, and the project-local workflow-evidence-retro Skill is deleted (#322 S3; Spec docs/specs/revisit-workflow-health.spec.md D6, D7, D10).

acceptance.assertion: In tests/review-retro-audit.test.ts, the Candidate improvements section groups in-window review findings by the normalized summary key of Spec D6; a group spanning two distinct runs is shown with its run count, finding count and up to three run-path#finding-id pointers, and a summary seen in only one run forms no group (Spec D6).

In tests/review-retro-audit.test.ts, a finding whose summary records a missing or cleaned-up reviewer agent or an empty verdict is listed under infrastructure jitter and is not counted in the content-rework count, while an ordinary review finding in the same run is (Spec D6).

In tests/review-retro-audit.test.ts, for a run with three or more review rework events the section prints one line per round with that round's finding acceptance ids and marks ids that repeat across rounds; a run with two review rework events gets no such listing (Spec D6).

tests/rework-root-cause-contract.test.ts reads plugins/immune-brain/dist/revisit.md and finds the three per-task aggregation sentences formerly locked in the workflow-evidence-retro Skill, the cross-boundary trace, the fix-ladder order architecture > types > lint > test > docs, and the rule that each candidate ends with a copy-ready TaskIntent or issue draft and revisit creates no issue, TaskIntent, branch or commit (Spec D6, D7; #322-D1).

.agents/skills/workflow-evidence-retro no longer exists, docs/reports/workflow-evidence-baseline.md no longer names workflow-evidence-retro and names revisit, and .changeset/revisit-s3-candidate-improvements.md declares a minor release of immune-brain (Spec D7, D10).
